212156.title: The Garden of Sinners: Future Gospel
212156.overview: A side story of the original Kara no Kyōkai - the Garden of sinners movie series divided into 2 parts. In the first part, Shizune Seo, who finds her life too predictable due to her precognition, and Mitsuru‎ Kamekura, who uses his precognition to be a professional bomber, meet Mikiya and Shiki, respectively, and their futures begin to change. In the second part, 10 years after the original series, Shiki and Mikiya's daughter, Mana Ryōgi, spends a day with Mitsuru.

347196.title: Wolf Creek: Legacy
347196.overview: A family of American tourists wander innocently into Taylor's hunting grounds. When the parents sacrifice themselves to save their children, the kids find themselves alone, lost and hunted in the vast Australian wilderness.

587196.title: Kaa - The Forest
587196.overview: When a Cold Blooded Murderer Victor Mahadev’s (Salim Ghouse) Killing Freak Gangs Chasing After Two Boys Into Deep Forests. A Wild Life Photographer Venba Subbaiya (Andrea Jeremiah) Got Into Their Game of Death by Accident. Who is Going to See the Next Dawn is the Unfolding Story. Whether Venba or Victor, Because Survival Really Matters in Deep Forest.

848700.title: Minotaur
848700.overview: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

868668.title: Ustaad Bhagat Singh
868668.overview: A tribal boy is shaped by the values of his teacher, who gives him the name 'Bhagat Singh'. He grows up deeply rooted in strong morals, which guide his actions throughout his life.He stands firm against injustice and takes on powerful evil forces, even when facing overwhelming odds.

873276.title: Sudesha
873276.overview: The story of a woman living in a village in the lower Himalayas. In this area, people depend entirely on the forest for their daily needs of firewood, food and water. But the forests have been destroyed by powerful timber traders. And along with the forest, the livelihood of the people has been greatly altered. The women of this region played an active role in the "Chipkow Movement". Sudesha was imprisoned for her protest.

1032892.title: In the Blink of an Eye
1032892.overview: Three storylines, spanning thousands of years, intersect and reflect on hope, connection, and the circle of life.

1124796.title: Cheat Sheet
1124796.overview: A young man invents a new cheating method to escape the hell of high school, which leads him into a funny cat and mouse game with a cunning teacher.
1124796.trailerName: Bershama Official Trailer |  إعلان فيلم برشامة

1151356.title: Soar
1151356.overview: Hyun-jae, a 16-year-old escaping her abusive father, manipulates Hae-in, a woman searching for her missing daughter, into taking her in as a replacement. Over the summer, Hyun-jae bonds with Hae-in, finding peace through her love for singing, but becomes obsessed with becoming Hae-in's new daughter. When Hae-in learns her missing daughter may have been found, Hyun-jae, despite her fears, makes a selfless decision to accompany her, realizing she can't replace Yun-seul.

1178620.title: Montreal, My Beautiful
1178620.overview: At 53 years old, Feng Xia, a Chinese immigrant in Montreal, finally confronts her repressed desire for women and begins a secret affair with a young Québécoise.
1178620.trailerName: Montreal, My Beautiful | Official Trailer | In theatres February 13, 2026

1242876.title: 500 Miles
1242876.overview: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

1251900.title: The Shrine
1251900.overview: Yu-mi and her friends are staying in a small Japanese town. When Hee-jung doesn't return home for dinner, they decide to visit the shrine from her painting. Strange occurrences startle them as they explore the shrine, even some end up injuring themselves. Yu-mi senses a sinister presence lurking within. She knows the right person for this, her old shaman friend named Myung-jin. Leaving the past behind with Yu-mi, he joins Pastor Han-ju, a spiritual leader of the town. Their mysterious cooperation to keep everyone safe is about to begin.
1251900.trailerName: BIFAN 2024 | 신사: 악귀의 속삭임 The Shrine Trailer

1265340.title: The Second Coming of John Cooper
1265340.overview: John Cooper, the biggest Hollywood star of his generation, partied away his career and vanished from the public eye. Years later, a documentary crew finds him living on the couch of his biggest fan in a tiny one bedroom apartment, and captures his moronic attempts to rebuild his career from scratch.
1265340.trailerName: The Second Coming of John Cooper | Official Trailer (2024)

1279548.title: At the Sea
1279548.overview: After a long rehabilitation, Laura returns to her family at their beach holiday home where she has to readjust to the complicated life she left behind. Now she is forced to face the following next chapter of her life without the career that gave her fame, fortune and, most importantly, identity.

1315772.title: Minions & Monsters
1315772.overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

1316092.title: "Wuthering Heights"
1316092.overview: Tragedy strikes when Heathcliff falls in love with Catherine Earnshaw, a woman from a wealthy family in 18th-century England.

1324988.title: Eklo I
1324988.overview: In the aftermath of a mysterious virus outbreak in 2030, humanity fled Earth. By 2090, the sole surviving human lives in the mountains of Nepal. When two astronauts, having settled in space, return to Earth, they inadvertently encounter this last human survivor. As they delve into the mountain mysteries, they uncover the chilling enigma of the zombies that now roam the land.
1324988.trailerName: EKLO-I - MOVIE OFFICIAL TRAILER 2082 || PRADEEP KHADKA, VIJAY LAMA, BENISHA HAMAL, KABITA NEPALI

1355132.title: Kupilih Jalur Langit
1355132.overview: Amira, a smart and spirited young woman studying at an Islamic boarding school, is thrilled when she enters an arranged marriage with Furqon, the cleric she has admired since her school days. But her happiness quickly fades when, even after their wedding night, Furqon never touches her. Doubts begin to grow—does her husband have a sexual disorder, or is something worse hiding beneath his silence? Could there be another woman he still loves?
1355132.trailerName: I Choose the Sky Path - Official Trailer

1361852.title: The convent
1361852.overview: Lucía and Ana Ma, two young postulants recently arrived at a small convent, find themselves involved in the strange events that occur there.

1365884.title: Call My Agent! The Movie
1365884.overview: Five years after ASK Agency closed, debut director Andréa loses her lead actor just days before filming and reunited with her old team — for better or worse.

1381564.title: Poca Pon
1381564.overview: Inspired by a bizarre murder case, this is the story of a family and the voice "POCA PON" — a voice that sometimes heals people, and sometimes destroys them.

1398460.title: A Second Life
1398460.overview: July 26, 2024 — the day of the Olympic Games Opening Ceremony. Elisabeth, a hearing impaired young woman, is torn between depression and the pressure of managing short-term rentals in a hectic Paris. The arrival of Elijah, a radiant and carefree Californian, disrupts her fragile balance.

1403836.title: The Bluey Movie
1403836.overview: On an action-packed day, a big surprise changes everything for Bluey and her family.

1404604.title: Compostelle
1404604.overview: Fred and Adam have nothing in common. Yet, they will meet while walking the Way of St. James as a form of spiritual path.

1406652.title: Audition 109
1406652.overview: The movie follows the journey of Jjang-gu, a man from Busan who moves to Seoul to pursue his dream of becoming a film actor.

1407548.title: Illusione
1407548.overview: Perugia. The police are carrying away the body of a young woman when they hear a sigh: Rosa Lazar is still alive. The assistant district attorney Cristina Camponeschi and psychologist Stefano Mangiaboschi investigate, but Rosa seems unaware of the attack she has endured and hides the truth. For Cristina, the girl is the key to an international crime ring; for Stefano, the start of an inner journey that will lead him to reveal the true enigma of Rosa Lazar.

1416636.title: I Swiped the Wrong One
1416636.overview: A typical rom-com with an atypical rom-com ending, I Swiped the Wrong One is the story of four thirtysomethings who attempt to navigate the world of 21st century online dating.

1418428.title: The Assassin(s)
1418428.overview: In 1974, a shooting shocks South Korea. Detective Cheol-gu, who witnesses the attack, Jae-hwan, the city desk editor whose coverage is suppressed, and Young-il, a rookie reporter, begin to dig beneath the cover-up. As their pursuit of the truth deepens, they come to confront forces meant to remain unseen.

1426940.title: Above the Line
1426940.overview: Described as combining the world of Swingers with the sensibility of Pulp Fiction, the L.A.-based comedy follows six Hollywood hopefuls who are roped into a harebrained plan to steal the Best Picture awards of a despised producer who has screwed each of them over as they struggle to make it big.

1427836.title: Checker Tobi 3 - Die heimliche Herrscherin der Erde
1427836.overview: Tobi revisits an old childhood riddle: Who leaves the deepest traces in the earth? His search takes him to places like Madagascar, Spitsbergen, and Mexico, where he uncovers what connects them and finds the answer he was missing as a child.

1431804.title: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
1431804.overview: Burned out on dating and ready to quit, Leah accepts her grandma's outrageous challenge: 40 dates in 40 nights for a full year of rent. From awkward dinners to unexpected sparks, she discovers the biggest obstacle to love might just be herself.

1434556.title: Focus
1434556.overview: Eun-ho, a photographer, acquires a used camera, only to discover a ghost appearing in his photos and reality. As the camera behaves erratically, he experiences terrifying hallucinations, ruining his relationship and jeopardizing his career. Seeking help, he turns to Gwang-myeong, a forensic hypnosis expert, to uncover the camera’s secrets and perform an exorcism.

1437948.title: The Blow
1437948.overview: Nineteen-year-old Enzo and his twenty-year-old sister Carla have been left to fend for themselves for several years. When their father, Anthony, is released from prison, Enzo sees the fragile promise of a family to rebuild, unlike Carla, for whom the idea remains inconceivable. Haunted by his past, Enzo must confront a truth he has kept hidden for far too long.

1447420.title: 9 Moons
1447420.overview: Ángel is a personal trainer who, after taking a year off, has just landed a job at the most prestigious gym in the city, and life finally seems to be back on track. But everything changes when he begins to feel unwell, goes to the hospital, and receives shocking news: he’s pregnant. A trans man on the verge of completing his transition, Ángel is now confronted with a life-altering decision—one that will challenge his identity, his aspirations, and his very understanding of masculinity.

1458300.title: The Mosquito Bowl
1458300.overview: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four US college football stars enlist in the Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

1472636.title: Un bel giorno
1472636.overview: Tommaso, a single father of four, has shut himself off from the world. When his daughters push him to start over, he meets Lara — a brilliant, captivating woman. But both carry secrets that could change everything.

1473148.title: Gentle Monster
1473148.overview: After relocating with her family to the countryside, a renowned pianist uncovers a life-shattering truth that forces her to confront the complexities of love, trust, and deception.

1486012.title: No More Time
1486012.overview: Following Doctor Professor Genius after Professor Jay and Doctor Zweistein left the Wild West in “Too Much Time“. More details TBA.

1490236.title: Scarecrows
1490236.overview: Those of us who fly in airplanes probably don’t think about those who fly through Riga Airport on their own wings. But on any given day, up to 30,000 birds might visit the airport. And it would only take one… Airport wildlife control employee Mareks would like to go to church and light a candle for luck before he goes to work every day. In fact, all of us need that luck – it’s just that we’re not aware of it. Maybe that’s a good thing. Understanding wildlife that might turn up at the airport and making sure that the paths of birds, animals and airplanes don’t cross is a very real job.

1494140.title: Petrushka
1494140.overview: Petya is almost 40 years old, he works as a chef in a restaurant and by his age he had achieved little in life. Petya has a wife and two children, but he is not respected by them. One day, he goes to his parents cottage, where he finds a box of old toys. Among them, he finds his favorite toy, Petrushka, because his name is the same as his own. Petya puts Petrushka on his arm, and a miracle happens - the toy comes to life. Now Petya has a difficult struggle with his alter ego, which will make him a real man.

1497788.title: Wild Nights, Tamed Beasts
1497788.overview: Delves into the realities of an aging society and centers on Ye Xiaolin – a former killer turned caregiver. She infiltrates and kills seniors under the guise of offering care, but her life takes an unexpected turn after a chance encounter with zookeeper Ma Deyong. As their fates become entangled and detective Zhou Ping begins to investigate the string of murders, a gripping story unfolds. The film raises awareness of aging-related societal issues by focusing on the themes of death, family dynamics, and the dignity of aging.

1501564.title: Wild Inside
1501564.overview: On February 2, 2023, Flaco — a male Eurasian eagle-owl, the largest species of owl in the world — was discovered missing from his cage at the Central Park Zoo in Manhattan. What follows when Flaco, who had lived his entire life in captivity, was released in New York City is a surprising story revealing the delight, concern, and fascination of millions in the city and beyond.
1501564.trailerName: WILD INSIDE - Flaco the Owl Documentary - Official Theatrical Trailer - In Theaters July 31st

1516092.title: Sahaa - Life of Sanju
1516092.overview: Sanju's journey from childhood to adulthood takes an emotional turn when he meets a young woman named Sahaa, whose presence awakens nostalgic memories from his past.

1530940.title: Bob and David Climb Machu Picchu
1530940.overview: Comedy legends Bob Odenkirk and David Cross tackle one of the world's toughest hikes — and each other — in this high-altitude, coca-fueled meditation on friendship, mortality, and profoundly absurd comedy from two icons still magnificently in sync.

1533820.title: Return of The Mack
1533820.overview: Ex-con Golden Mickens learns his daughter's trapped in a trafficking ring. Using his street knowledge, he must confront his criminal past and navigate Detroit's underworld to save her.

1536252.title: No Sex
1536252.overview: A college girl must navigate her unspoken feelings for her best friend — and race to protect her — when a drunken night spirals out of control.

1537212.title: Huwag Kang Titingin
1537212.overview: A group of friends triggers a supernatural curse through a social media trend, unleashing ancient, sinister forces tied to local myths.
1537212.trailerName: Huwag Kang Titingin | OFFICIAL MOVIE TRAILER

1542396.title: Salmones Rosas
1542396.overview: Dominic is a once-celebrated and acclaimed painter who, having left his best years behind, will desperately try to regain his former artistic glory.

1546876.title: Mycardiumopathy
1546876.overview: An experimental documentary that explores heart muscle disease and the impact a diagnosis can have on a young person’s outlook on life.

1551036.title: Seporsi Mie Ayam Sebelum Mati
1551036.overview: If today were your last day, what one small thing would you really want to do?  For Ale, the answer is simple: enjoy a bowl of his favorite chicken noodles before he truly gives up on life. But when his regular food cart is closed, that situation leads him into a series of unexpected encounters.

1551484.title: Mom's Alive Today
1551484.overview: Jakov returns to hometown in order to take care of his mother whose suffering from a schizoaffective disorder, however, this intense new element in his life will slowly start to make his own psyche crack.

1554364.title: Full Phil
1554364.overview: Wealthy American industrialist Philip Doom attempts to reconnect with his daughter Madeleine during a luxurious trip to Paris. Unfortunately, French cuisine, a 1950s horror film, and an intrusive hotel employee disrupt their stay.

1561340.title: Hand of God
1561340.overview: In a remote village scarred by years of conflict, a young army lieutenant introduces football to children. As the game begins to heal wounds and rebuild trust, he forms a fragile bond with a child soldier — forcing both to choose between the innocence they’ve lost and the violent realities of war.

1571900.title: Dead Eyes
1571900.overview: After the death of his sister, Sean and his friends venture into a remote forest to search for his missing father, only to uncover his dark secrets, where grief has become a bridge between the living and the dead.

1573756.title: The Hollow Season
1573756.overview: In the remote mountain town of Graven Hollow, autumn is more than just a season — it’s a warning. Every thirteen years, as the harvest moon rises and the leaves turn blood-red, the town prepares for a ritual it dares not speak aloud. When a group of college friends arrives for the annual fall festival, they’re drawn into a chilling legend about the Hollow Man — a masked figure born of fire and betrayal, who returns to collect a blood debt. As the friends unravel the town’s secrets and fight to survive, they discover that tradition runs deep… and some roots are soaked in horror.

1586108.title: Artificial
1586108.overview: An undercover cop is assigned to monitor a humanoid robot, but an unexpected bond over art leads to a final task: creating a painting.

1586876.title: Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of the Mermaid Island
1586876.overview: Chiikawa and friends set off on a whimsical summer adventure to a mysterious island said to hide a long-lost mermaid secret. What starts as a fun getaway quickly turns into a heartwarming journey filled with surprises, gentle thrills, and adorable chaos. With sparkling seas, strange legends, and unforgettable encounters, the trio learns about courage, friendship, and the magic hidden in small moments.

1587964.title: They Fight
1587964.overview: Reformed ex-convict Walt Manigan returns home to rebuild his family with the love of his life, Ketta. His path leads him to a boxing gym inside a D.C. youth recreation center about to be closed. There, he works under the wise coach Slim to mentor a group of boys to train for the junior national boxing tournament, all leading to a showdown between best friends Quincey and Peanut as they battle for a spot on the U.S. Junior Olympic Team.

1595580.title: Loss
1595580.overview: Amy is having the worst day of her life. Her 16-year-old daughter, Emma, is finally undergoing a heart transplant after waiting over two years. As Emma fights for her life, Amy sits alone in the hospital waiting room, overwhelmed by fear, exhaustion, and a deep anger towards God. She tries to pray but can’t find the words, consumed by rage at the unfairness of it all.

1601148.title: Malvina
1601148.overview: Malvina is an angel sent to earth for being ignorant of it's problems. she falls to earth and after an incounter with a grieving mother seeks adamentley the love she talks about. when receiving this love finally she becomes addicted. she is filled with so much love for everyone she eventually loses herself completely in the desires and wants of everyone around her.

1603388.title: Dushi Curaçao
1603388.overview: Roos travels alone to Curaçao to distance herself from her life in the Netherlands — and from her fiancé Roel, with whom she no longer feels a connection. While those around her believe they’re the perfect couple, deep down Roos knows it’s over. On the island, she meets Stijn, a defense worker, with whom she shares an intense connection. But Roos hides her background and invents a new story about who she is. As the island pulls her further away from home, the truth threatens to catch up with her.

1605116.title: Brave New Love
1605116.overview: Hypnotherapist Kate lives with her husband, Orla, and their daughter, Athena, while simultaneously maintaining a deeply romantic - and highly secret - relationship with Andreas. As a role model to her daughter, she struggles to navigate her existential quest - a journey filled with body fluids, intimacy, Greek mythology, laughter, madness, and clumsiness. We follow Kate through darkness and sunshine in this erotic, existential modern love story, as she battles society’s norms and dares to redefine the rules of love.

1605372.title: Il malloppo
1605372.overview: Diego Viani is a former robber, well-known in the 1980s for his "unarmed" heists. His best friend is Michele Ragusa, a shabby private investigator scraping by on cases of marital infidelity. Working alongside him is Alex, an unpaid intern—a clumsy "mama’s boy" who dreams of becoming a detective despite having no talent for it.  Everything spirals out of control when Diego’s past resurfaces in the form of Salamandra, an old accomplice. Salamandra accuses him of stealing the loot from their final job: five billion lire in gold bullion that vanished into thin air.  When Salamandra dies under mysterious circumstances, Diego becomes the prime suspect. Commissioner Castrone, fueled by a long-standing personal vendetta, is convinced of his guilt. The only person who believes in Diego’s innocence is Ragusa, who decides to investigate with the help of the unlikely Alex.

1610748.title: Brailled It
1610748.overview: Blind and low-vision kids take control of the cameras and capture their own experiences at the annual Braille Challenge — a weekend of high-pressure competition and raw coming-of-age moments.

1614268.title: Echo
1614268.overview: A guy with a bad work history gets a job as a night watchman at an office building. What seems like an easy job turns into a living hell for the protagonist when he encounters a paranormal phenomenon that awakens at night. Now, what used to be harmless can turn into a threat.

1616188.title: The Garden We Dreamed
1616188.overview: In a land not their own, amid a dwindling forest, a family carves out a fragile bubble of tenderness – a fleeting garden of hope where love can still take root.

1617852.title: Speed Faster
1617852.overview: Ace and his crew of elite street racers are forced into a high-stakes mission when a shadowy organization threatens someone close to him. In the aftermath of Four Amigos, they find themselves working for the infamous Church of Assassins, tasked with pulling off an impossible job. But as they push their limits, they uncover a chilling truth-failure was always part of the plan. Betrayal, speed, and survival collide in this adrenaline-fueled thriller where the real race isn't just for victory, but for their lives.

1623740.title: Snake 5: Monster City
1623740.overview: After escaping prison during a monster attack, convict Wu Chuan must navigate a city overrun by prehistoric creatures and lead a desperate fight to save his trapped mother and stop an ancient beast from destroying the city.

1623996.title: NOT BAD
1623996.overview: A biting look at domestic inequality set in a mid-century modern home.

1624828.title: No Love 1/2
1624828.overview: A cocktail mix of yuri with neo-noir and girls-with-guns.

1629372.title: The Way We Move
1629372.overview: Amber Galloway, a trailblazer in ASL interpretation, takes us on a journey into the deep bond between the Deaf world and music. We follow her as she teaches struggling recruits who she hopes will have what it takes to join her at ACL music festival.

1631292.title: Ice Beast
1631292.overview: When a young girl goes out to search for her missing grandfather, the cold is not the only thing she has to survive. As night falls and the snow closes in, she begins to realize she is not alone and whatever is out there has been waiting.

1632188.title: The Fire Within You
1632188.overview: Antonio, who fled Naples many years ago, has built a family and a successful career in Milan, far from his mother Angela — a woman excessive in both her virtues and her flaws, irresistible, old-fashioned and hostile like few others — who has come to visit for Christmas and seems determined to stay.  Christmas Eve dinner becomes an emotional battlefield, at once comic and fierce, bringing to the surface a past of impositions and misunderstandings. With a stubborn capon that refuses to end up in the pot, a daughter whose arrival remains uncertain, and an unexpected distinguished guest, the evening turns into a reckoning between mother and son destined to change the meaning of their bond forever: a love that burns like a fire within, one that never dies out — not even by leaving.
1632188.trailerName: BIFF2026 Trailer | 메리 크리스마스, 엄마 The Fire Within You | 월드 시네마

1639356.title: Sidosa
1639356.overview: In 'Sidosa', the director and actor Eduardo Casanova makes the most intimate and significant revelation of his life: he has HIV. There is no precedent in Spain for a public figure to disclose that he is living with HIV — a step that organizations and activists have been calling for for years to help end the social stigma still associated with the virus.

1642940.title: Don't Kill Loretta
1642940.overview: At a wellness retreat deep in Germany's forests, a group of young Americans encounter a terrifying presence after a night of partying. As fear and paranoia take hold, they must uncover the truth before it's too late.

1646844.title: The Salesman
1646844.overview: After the death of his wife, a man is greeted by an enthusiastic salesman.

1650428.title: Metropolitan Ride
1650428.overview: Soobin finally lands a job! With a fluttering heart, she steps into the elevator on her first day. However, countless obstacles still lie between her and her destination: the 7,891st floor. This handmade sci-fi film, created with quiet persistence using 100% analog methods, was made over the past two years, coinciding with the rise of AI as it began to threaten art.

1650556.title: To Be
1650556.overview: Jack Adler is a dreamer. He feels that soulless poetry recitation is an injustice to the meaning between the lines, and he hungers for connection with others who cherish the truth of storytelling as much as he does. When Jack stumbles upon an artistic safe haven, he learns he may not be so alone after all.

1652988.title: PWRCR33P
1652988.overview: A lonely arcade regular finds fame and belonging through a new VR game that places him atop a global leaderboard—until cracks in the simulation force him to question what winning actually means.

1665724.title: Shera
1665724.overview: A high-energy action drama centered on strength, loyalty, and confrontation. The story unfolds through intense moments and gripping action as the protagonist faces powerful forces and personal challenges.
1665724.trailerName: Shera | Parmish Verma | Sonal Chauhan | In Cinemas on 15th May 2026

1667772.title: The Dendrill
1667772.overview: While preparing their childhood home for sale, Mark reunites with his estranged stepbrother, Francis, who insists the forest never forgot them.

1669180.title: Life Coach
1669180.overview: A lonely Muay Thai instructor (Mark Bale) seeks self-confidence through an online life-coaching app, gradually surrendering control to an unseen mentor.

1671548.title: Dear You
1671548.overview: Grandma Ye Shurou from Chaoshan lived a simple life, enjoying her twilight years. Her grandson, Xiaowei, burdened by debt, secretly traveled to Thailand to find his rumored billionaire grandfather, Zheng Musheng. However, Xiaowei returned with shocking news: his grandfather was long gone, and the person with whom Grandma had exchanged love letters was a complete stranger. As Xiaowei investigated, a love affair hidden for half a century suddenly surfaced, striking Grandma's heart.

1674236.title: Noga
1674236.overview: Fearless alternative pop singer Noga Erez is on the brink of superstardom with a unique, captivating sound and a major studio album on the way. But when war erupts and cracks appear in her relationship, Noga must redefine her role as an artist on a global stage.

1675324.title: Ephemera
1675324.overview: In post-pandemic Shanghai, two women — one leaving, one staying — share a single electric night wandering the city. A tender, breezy queer love story where chemistry, connection and bittersweet goodbyes feel thrillingly alive.

1677244.title: 4000 Days
1677244.overview: Chronicles the relentless fight of three families—Gary and Julie DeVercelly, Linda and Eric Oakes, and TJ and Kim Burch—who turned their personal tragedies into a nationwide movement for change. After losing their sons to fraternity hazing, the families found themselves up against a deeply entrenched system that thrived on secrecy, denial, and silence. Refusing to accept that their children died in vain, they joined forces and waged a years-long battle to expose the dangers of hazing, challenge university and fraternity accountability, and push for sweeping legislative reform.

1678844.title: The Bus: A French Football Mutiny
1678844.overview: This documentary revisits the French football team's controversial 2010 World Cup and the bus strike that sparked global headlines and national outrage.

1678972.title: The Book of Dreaming
1678972.overview: A young woman begins to work on a dream journal after she realizes that all of her travels to the dreamscape (be they dreams or nightmares) are related to an old cemetary situated nearby her childhood home.

1679036.title: Groundswell
1679036.overview: Viewers travel around the world, getting a global perspective on the three biggest (and interrelated) problems our species faces – climate change, species loss and soil loss. More importantly, viewers will learn about the multitude of methods in which regeneration is addressing and even reversing these trends on an ecosystem-by-ecosystem basis, all while storing enough carbon in the ground to help mitigate our changing climate.

1679932.title: My Girlfriend Turned Into a Worm
1679932.overview: When his girlfriend inexplicably turns into a worm, Arthur builds her a miniature world in an attempt to process his grief.

1681340.title: Just One More
1681340.overview: A recovering addict, Jess, meets Charles, a dying man praying God will use him "just one more" time. As their lives collide, Jess battles shame, and doubt-discovering faith, forgiveness, and the hope to fight for a future beyond addiction.
1681340.trailerName: Just One More | Official Trailer | Premiering on Angel May 14th

1686140.title: Buried
1686140.overview: Michael Sheen follows in campaigner Douglas Gowan's footsteps, exposing the dangers of Monsanto's toxic PCBs and their continued effect on communities in the UK.

1686780.title: Showstopper
1686780.overview: A young woman is trapped in the clutches of a musical-obssesed serial killer, having to perform for her life to free herself from the perfection she is expected to achieve.

1687868.title: De Grote Mensen Stad
1687868.overview: A young man walks through the city he once looked up to. As everyone around him seems to move with purpose, he wonders if becoming an adult means keeping up or simply finding your own pace.

1688892.title: O Mez da Grippe
1688892.overview: In Curitiba, a university professor begins researching the Spanish flu. As he gathers photographs, testimonies, and fragments of memory, the investigation starts to slip out of control. Amid immigrant voices, archival images, and echoes of a haunted city, the past returns as an enigma that refuses to fade.

1689212.title: Keep The Faith
1689212.overview: Lorraine Carter lives a quiet, contemptuous life in the mundane suburbs of Lincoln. She is restless, discontented and dreams of what once was and what could have been. Having once lived on the road, gigging as the lead singer in a punk band, Lorraine was a real rock star, or came close to being one. With the band's burgeoning dreams being cut short, and life sweeping her forward, Lorraine's life as a proud punk-rocker seemed over. Swapping punk for a nine-to-five, and the microphone for motherhood, Lorraine watched from the margins as her life sped by. Beaten, forgotten, and belittled by the world around her, Lorraine grows tempestuous. She yearns to reclaim her creative identity, to express herself and to fight for what she believes in. She prepares to come to terms with her past, to overcome her fears, and to take the stage once again. With a microphone in hand, she sings a simple phrase. Keep the faith, it’s all we’ve got.

1689852.title: The Last Wild River
1689852.overview: Dr Struzynski spent decades fighting for the survival of noble crayfish. A documentary journey into nature, between fairy tale and reality, reflecting on resilience, dedication, and belief that even one person can change the world.

1693436.title: Pinay Kamasutra
1693436.overview: Hosted by Ataska, Pinay Kama Sutra returns for another sizzling volume as she explores fifteen daring positions inspired by iconic VMX movie moments. Get in rhythm, feel every move, and prepare for a hotter, sweatier experience.
1693436.trailerName: PINAY KAMA SUTRA | WORLD PREMIERE THIS MAY 19 EXCLUSIVELY ON VMX

1695868.title: Vanished
1695868.overview: A highschooler goes missing and one student, Jack, is determined to find him. His friends advise against him doing this again, but he is captured by the search. However, he may not like what he finds.

1696764.title: The Island of Giants
1696764.overview: An inspiring story that shows how the presence of a marine species can affect the entire economy and the whole society of one of the smallest islands of the Azores, the Island of Santa Maria.  It is the only place in Europe where a large number of whale sharks are sighted and in addition their migration is shrouded in mystery, no one knows where they come from, where they are going … and why they appear surrounded by thousands of tunas.  It also accompanies the scientific expeditions that for 11 years have tried to unveil the secrets of these giants and to know if their recent presence is linked to global warming and rising water temperatures around the Azores.
1696764.trailerName: Protected areas - Nuno Sa  film Giant islands

1698172.title: Josiane
1698172.overview: A Marseille “cagole” is quietly making her breakfast, completely unaware of what’s about to happen to her…

1698684.title: On a Stringer
1698684.overview: At noon, in the shade of riverside trees — as if in the middle of life — you lose something. Yet love is as strong as the river. A man is going through abrupt changes in his life — both personal and caused by the war. He spends a day alone by the river, revisiting a forgotten hobby — fishing. A sense of love and acceptance fills him, but only for a brief moment — he must return to the war.

1700348.title: Зоопарк
1700348.overview: *Zoo* is a film about what happens when a person takes responsibility for another living being. It is about the people who choose this work—once—and stay forever. About animals that fell victim to inhumane treatment but were saved within the zoo. And about how the world increasingly needs places like this—places where every life is priceless.

1701692.title: Killer Curve
1701692.overview: After her brother is murdered, Jade Carter uncovers a secret list linking powerful elites to a deadly conspiracy. As corrupt forces close in, she must outsmart both criminals and law enforcement to expose the truth - and survive long enough to get revenge.

1703804.title: PegaSUS
1703804.overview: A group of kids touring the state's top-ranked school realises something darker is beneath its perfect reception.

1705276.title: Learning, Studying… Always Perfecting: The Making of One Battle After Another
1705276.overview: A behind-the-scenes documentary filmed during the production of Paul Thomas Anderson’s One Battle After Another, featuring candid moments from the cast and crew.

1707132.title: Europiano (2/2)  - The finest piano concertos from across Europe
1707132.overview: In the second part of this magnificent concert celebrating music from across Europe, Lukas Sternath, Martha Argerich, Bruce Liu and Hayato Sumino perform the finest piano concertos by Beethoven, Schumann, Tchaikovsky and Rachmaninoff.

1711676.title: Almost with You
1711676.overview: Still devastated by the recent death of his brother, an Irish singer-songwriter on a solo tour of Australia finds himself in a remote West Australian town with 5 days off before the final show of the tour.
1711676.trailerName: ALMOST WITH YOU -  New! First Look TEASER

1712700.title: F*ck de Familie
1712700.overview: When brother Ben suddenly dies, Bo (Yolanthe Cabau) gets with her husband Saïd the care assigned for Ben's teenage daughter Emma. She wants to do this as well as possible, but clashes already quickly with the rest of the family. Everyone - Bo's parents first - thinks to know what is best for Emma. While her demanding job drives her further and further into a corner, Bo's marriage wavers and all good intentions degenerate into a battle full of old pain, new secrets and family dramas that no therapy helps against.

1712828.title: Water Park Shark
1712828.overview: Sharks breach a seaside water park during the debut of a new ride, forcing a lifeguard and the town’s police chief to contain the chaos and protect guests from becoming prey.

1715068.title: Watch Out, Kid
1715068.overview: A young man is drawn to a handsome guy, but his insecurities stand in his way.

1715388.title: Knives
1715388.overview: A juxtaposition of knives, scissors, weapons, and bombs in photographic format while showing women victims of Iranian attacks in Palestine.

1719356.title: Taxi
1719356.overview: A man in his mid 50s becomes a Taxi driver to help pay for something, will he manage to?

1719676.title: Take His Life
1719676.overview: Beneath the glitter of London's finance world, a destitute man forces his way back from the streets into power. Over the course of a week, his hunger for success hardens into obsession, exposing a ruthless truth: in a system built on glass, survival demands taking another's life.

1720636.title: Dead Parents Club
1720636.overview: Dead Parents Club is a hybrid documentary blending observational footage, experimental performance, and cultural analysis to challenge the pervasive "orphan trope" in popular culture.  While children's media like The Lion King, Frozen, and Finding Nemo frequently use parental loss as a narrative tool to spark a character's independence, the lived reality of grief is vastly more complex.  The film follows real individuals who have lost parents as they collaborate on a unique theatre production. By stepping into the roles of iconic fictional orphans like Simba and Frodo, the cast members weave their personal stories of trauma into the scripted scenes. The resulting performance offers a poignant, absurd, and unexpectedly funny exploration of identity and healing.  Moving between fantasy and lived experience, this documentary examines how we navigate profound loss, build deep connections, and ultimately learn to parent ourselves.

1721404.title: (in)significant
1721404.overview: Through contemplation of our place within the universe, (in)significant is a mixed-media film that finds beauty in simple moments, anchored in the warmth of the sun on a nostalgic summer day.

1722172.title: Grifter
1722172.overview: A young man tries to jumpstart his career as an influencer by leaning into conservatism, disregarding the feelings of those around him.

1723068.title: Hammerhead Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
1723068.overview: In Mexico’s Pacific waters, Bertie Gregory goes in search of one of the ocean’s most iconic predators: the hammerhead shark. Once abundant in these seas, hammerhead numbers have plummeted, making sightings increasingly rare. Bertie investigates what’s driving the hammerhead decline, and how protected waters offer hope for the future. His journey culminates in a rare and unforgettable encounter that shines a light on the future of one of the world’s most famous sharks.

1723708.title: Forbidden Treasure
1723708.overview: In this Cliff Hanger short, treasure hunters finally discover the lost treasure of Amon Gu'ul but are soon divided by their own desires...

1725116.title: Simpsley
1725116.overview: When penniless con-artist Marge Bouvier is sent to Italy to convince wealthy sap Seymour Skinner to come home, she’s tempted by the trappings of his affluent lifestyle. But there’s a big fat fly in the ointment: Skinner’s clingy, dim-witted mooch of a houseguest, Homer Simpsley. Lies, lust and Italian lira are abound.

1726972.title: Pinaka
1726972.overview: Pinaka (2026), Action Drama Fantasy Period Thriller in Kannada language

1727484.title: Double Barrel
1727484.overview: A thirst for power pulls Surya into a deadly rivalry. But once the violence begins, is there any way back?
1727484.trailerName: Double Barrel Trailer | Premieres On 3rd July On Aha | Siva Sankara Chakravarthy | Aditya Bheemreddy

1729340.title: Sensai
1729340.overview: A nymph who longs for the sky sets out to craft the dress that will turn her into a star, transforming her insecurities into creativity.

1729916.title: Bloom
1729916.overview: Leo, a shy young florist, knocks on the wrong door during a flower delivery and meets Noah, a charismatic dancer. As their unexpected romantic bond deepens, Leo embarks on a journey toward love, adulthood and self-acceptance.

1730620.title: The One Next Door
1730620.overview: When a mysterious stranger moves in next door to Robert and Tabitha, boundaries are tested, loyalty is questioned, and danger comes for all.
1730620.trailerName: The One Next Door | Official Trailer | Tubi Original

1733692.title: FLAPJAX
1733692.overview: An over-eager fast-food manager is tasked with reviving a highly addictive menu item called "FLAPJAX" to save his fast-food company from bankruptcy. He pulls his estranged mother, a faded pop-star known as Popo, out of retirement to promote the item. However, he soon becomes ensnared by the company's true intentions and his deeply rooted mommy issues.

1734716.title: Obitus
1734716.overview: After a devastating flood, a mysterious parasitic outbreak engulfs a remote village. As Luna and her father, Damien, struggle to survive, they're forced to confront the brutality of nature and the darkest side of humanity. Filled with separation, loss, and horrifying truths, their journey changes their fate forever.

1737532.title: Surrr naks klik
1737532.overview: A short film by Roosa Vuokkola.

1737852.title: The Balkan Cowboy
1737852.overview: With the help of the locals from the small town of Bijelina, artist and filmmaker Dragana Jurišić attempts to recreate the films of self-taught western director Aljoš Musli, also known as Hari Džekson

1738108.title: Operation Playground: Zero
1738108.overview: After the death of his mother, Ricky, a twelve-year-old non-verbal boy, is left to care for his infant sister on his own while struggling to survive in a collapsing Western Europe overrun by the living dead

1740412.title: FILIZ
1740412.overview: Filiz is communicating with a voice coming from an old sound recorder. Meanwhile she is causing musical trouble with her friends, taking care of a grandmother and trying not to be discovered in her hideaway underneath the city.

1742204.title: Tracers
1742204.overview: Tracers follows a group of young American soldiers from basic training through their combat experiences in Vietnam and, for those who survive, their difficult return to civilian life. The film explores the legacy of the original stage production, which was created by Vietnam veterans and became one of the most influential artistic works about the war. Perniciaro's film combines documentary storytelling with staged performance to tell both the story of the play and the experiences that inspired it.

1742332.title: The Widower
1742332.overview: Mirsad is a 62-year-old electrician who was raised and lives in a patriarchal society. His daily routine changes after the sudden death of his wife Enisa. Mirsad stays alone while his grown children live their own lives. As Mirsad tries to get used to a life without his wife, he realizes that he took her for granted and had not given her the love and care she deserved. Mirsad's relationship with his estranged son worsens after he discovers that the son lives with a male friend.

1742844.title: Mon Amour
1742844.overview: Lawyer John Sweet arrives at a tense will reading that will decide who will get artist Theodore Windsor's painting called 'Mon Amour'.

1747260.title: The Drug in Our Pocket
1747260.overview: Examines how smartphones, designed to connect us, have radically reshaped childhood, adolescence and mental health. Through intimate conversations with young people, parents, and leading experts, the film reveals a generation that is thoughtful, articulate, and increasingly aware of how digital environments shape their attention, emotions, and sense of self.

1747580.title: Déjà Vu or Already Seen
1747580.overview: Ahab, Ida and Will stumble through a mad world of adolescence, independence, Cornwall, postmodern determinism in a loose adaptation of Kurt Vonnegut Jr.’s ‘Breakfast of Champions’.

1750908.title: I am 18 or older
1750908.overview: A conscription notice forces 20-year-old Marvin to reevaluate his life: between porn addiction, poverty, and failed intimacy, he struggles to find stability—and considers military service as a radical new beginning.

1754364.title: Making Marie Antoinette
1754364.overview: Eleanor Coppola's behind-the-scenes documentation of her daughter Sofia Coppola directing the 2006 film Marie Antoinette, capturing the craftsmanship and challenges of being a young female director.

1756220.title: Zoe & Aubrey
1756220.overview: Two friends from college reconnect after several years, little do they know they will discover something very unexpected.

1757692.title: Wild Mushrooms
1757692.overview: After the death of the enigmatic TV detective, a curious girl finds refuge in her garden, where she begins to uncover the strange connection between death and her mother’s melancholy.

1758972.title: I Went to Check On You Sleep
1758972.overview: Thirty-five years in the life of a couple, told through 2,000 notes and family photographs. Love, jealousy, pain, resilience, and death, reflected upon by Aldir Blanc, the creator of some of the most beautiful lyrics in Brazilian popular music — including “O Bêbado e a Equilibrista” (“The Drunkard and the Tightrope Walker”), written for his wife, Mari Lúcia.  Six years after Aldir’s death, the notes continue to emerge, hidden inside objects throughout the couple’s apartment in Rio de Janeiro’s Tijuca neighborhood. Mari revisits forgotten moments and opens the moving treasure trove of notes in the year Aldir — who died of COVID-19 in 2020 — would have turned 80.

1760316.title: Reform
1760316.overview: A man spirals within a never-ending work day and is visited by another being.

1760380.title: Como Dominar o Mundo (ou Meninos Mimados)
1760380.overview: While Marcelo and his childhood friends, João Gabriel and João Tadeu, wait to watch the Flamengo game, Marianne, his ex-girlfriend, sends him a voice message saying that her intimate photos have been leaked. Unsure of how to react and prompted by one of the Joãos, Marcelo starts a conversation about whether young people like them could take over the world.

1763388.title: Holterline
1763388.overview: After the death of her beloved father, devastated Angeliki is given the opportunity to embark on a unique 24-hour journey into the unconscious, while wearing a Holter heart monitor.

1763900.title: Cocaine
1763900.overview: "Cocaine" is a gripping crime thriller that delves deep into the murky intersection of law enforcement and criminality. Set against the vibrant yet perilous backdrop of Mumbai, the story revolves around a powerful drug cartel that wields significant control over the cocaine trade with the connivance of corrupt police officials and politicians. Abhimanyu Singh stars as Jalal, a diligent police inspector who finds himself entangled in the cartel's sinister web. Despite his best efforts to stay above board, Jalal must go to extreme lengths to protect his own brother, who is targeted by the ruthless cartel. As Jalal navigates the perilous dualities of upholding the law while safeguarding his family, he becomes ensnared in a dangerous game of survival.
1763900.trailerName: COCAINE | Official Trailer | Abhimanyu Singh, Ashok Samarth, Nissar Khan, Uday Tikekar, Mushtaq Khan

1767548.title: Worm Regards
1767548.overview: A group of four friends are hired by the mysterious Mr. E to retrieve and deliver to him the remains of the equally mysterious Maurice Thomas Graves, resulting in many strange interactions at his café.
